assistAttempts.changedStrategy: Used the current SEC Q2 2026 filing as a primary-source acquisition/capital-allocation path rather than repeating prior issuer narrative and filing-mirror evidence.
Used the FY2026 SEC 10-K risk/performance disclosures to source-address commissioning, acceptance, financing, concentration, supplier and obsolescence risks without assigning Alpha numeric risk.

result: Owned Beta routing queue was empty, so spare capacity was used on two active Alpha risk-source-support assists. Both produced bounded, source-addressed evidence while leaving underwriting and numeric scoring with Council Alpha.

learning.lesson: When Beta owns no closure work, primary SEC risk disclosures can reduce Alpha risk-evidence uncertainty without crossing into numeric underwriting; avoid retrying unchanged dormant inputs.
